headline_hook: Claude Code Gets Eyes and Hands While OpenAI Ships a Plugin to Live Inside It
preview_topics: why the enterprise replacement window is wide open

pick_of_the_day.thesis: OpenAI shipping a plugin that runs inside Anthropic's CLI isn't generosity — it's a bet that the default AI workspace matters more than the model layer, and whoever owns the developer's terminal wins regardless of whose weights run underneath.

model_literacy.relevance: Claude Code's computer use launch makes coding agents visual — they can now see screens, click buttons, and verify their own output. Understanding how GUI agents differ from API-only agents (pixel-level perception vs. structured DOM access, action grounding, visual verification loops) is key to knowing when this capability actually helps vs. when it's overhead.
